Over-estimated by 2.62x on the measure the estimate was stated in: 5.5h of active engineering predicted, ~2.1h spent. Scored MISS rather than partial by this project's own arithmetic -- praxis.agents.reconciliation.quality_for bands 2.619 as a miss because partial ends below 2.50 -- and the author does not get a softer band than the corpus does. It is the largest over-estimate in this record, beating OUT-0005's 2.18x, and the first active-time miss since OUT-0002. FIFTH outcome in agent-implementation and the FIFTH consecutive over-estimate in that class: 1.31x, 2.18x, 1.40x, 1.79x, 2.62x. THE THRESHOLD IS NOW CROSSED. agent-implementation reaches n = 5, which is exactly BiasDetective's MINIMUM_SAMPLE, so for the first time in this project the product can speak about its own author. Computed by the code shipped in this phase rather than by hand: factor 0.5556 (multiply a raw estimate by this), read as 1.80x OVER, band 1.3461x to 2.4062x, log-space dispersion 0.2905, confidence 0.3875. That confidence is deliberately low and the design is what makes it so - n/(n+5) caps the sample term at exactly one half at the threshold, so a group that has only just cleared the bar reads as a coin-flip-grade signal. EST-0009 is therefore the first estimate in this project's history that BiasDetective can legitimately be asked about, and the honest way to write it is to run `praxis calibrate --owner claude-opus-5 --work-class agent-implementation --quantity <raw>` and quote what comes back - including deciding, with the band and the confidence in hand, whether to apply it. Applying it is not automatically right: the band spans 1.35x to 2.41x, which is nearly a factor of two wide, and ADR 0024 exists precisely so that width is visible rather than hidden behind a point estimate. That was the wrong lever: the sub-population difference was real and it belonged in the number. Recorded here so that EST-0009 has it, and so that the n = 5 factor now available is read alongside it rather than instead of it - a factor fitted across five phases that were four-fifths model-driven is being offered to a phase that may not be, which is precisely the question about sub-populations that n = 5 still cannot answer. Phase 8, the fusion layer, closed. 3.5h active against 3.6h predicted -- match_quality EXACT, computed by praxis.agents.reconciliation.quality_for rather than labelled by hand. Ratio estimated-over-actual 1.0286. THIS IS THE FIRST EXACT MATCH IN THIS PROJECT'S HISTORY, AND IT IS ALSO THE FIRST BIAS-CORRECTED ESTIMATE. The two facts are worth stating together and worth not over-reading, so both are recorded here. WHAT THE CORRECTION DID. EST-0009 built a raw estimate of 6.5h bottom-up by exactly the procedure the five fitted estimates used, then multiplied it by the measured factor 0.5556 to log 3.6h. Had the raw number been logged uncorrected, as the previous eight were, this phase would have come in at 6.5/3.5 = 1.857x over -- which sits almost exactly on the fitted factor of 1.7999x over, in the middle of the 1.35x-2.41x band, and would have been the sixth consecutive over-estimate. So the correction did not merely help: the raw estimate missed by close to the amount the estimator's own history predicted it would, which is the strongest single result this project has produced about itself. WHAT IT DOES NOT SHOW. n=1. One estimate landing on the nose after a correction is consistent with the factor being right and is not evidence that it is; the same outcome would follow from a lucky raw estimate and an offsetting error. The honest test is prequential and it starts now: OUT-0009 takes agent-implementation to six, and ScoringAgent needs one point MORE than MINIMUM_SAMPLE to grade its first row, so this is the first outcome in the project's history that a backtest can score at all. That number, not this one, is the evidence. THE SUB-POPULATION CONDITION HELD. EST-0009 disclosed that agent-implementation is not homogeneous -- it contains Phase 7 at 2.62x over with no model call and Phase 5 at 1.41x with five -- and predicted that Phase 8 being model-driven again made it a better fit for the factor than Phase 7 had been. It was, and the class was not split to make it so. BLOCKED: 0.1h, and for the first time the number means something, because it is nearly zero for a real reason rather than by accident: the phase ran straight through in one continuous session with no credit exhaustion between components. Predicted 12.0h against 0.1h actual, which is the sixth consecutive miss on blocked time and the sixth confirmation that it measures when the author sleeps rather than when the work waits. Compare active against active. SCOPE: every condition EST-0009 set was met with one deliberate deviation stated in advance -- ReviewTriageAgent is not in this phase. The riskiest line item, cross-document outcome matching, was built and did NOT spend ADR 0015: the invariant is about one call rather than one estimate, so running the single-document matcher once per document honours it exactly. Six new modules, all at 100%, three ADRs, 2776 tests passing at 98.93% coverage.
